native_mechanism_note: LOSSY: recipe = alpha-fade + amber bloom overlay; fadewhite != amber bloom (color/aesthetic lost); projector sting preserved via overlay.
description: Warm orange/amber bloom that consumes clip_a and reveals clip_b — emulates film burning through the gate of a projector. Cinema/horror aesthetic with strong nostalgia cue.

ffmpeg_params.burn_start: Set = duration(clip_a) - 0.6. Last 0.6s of clip_a burns out while clip_b fades in.

audio_recipe: acrossfade 0.6s + optional film-splicer/celluloid SFX (e.g., _archive-legacy-projects/cinema-abandonado-v2/sfx/film_splicer_cortafilm_cut.mp3) at volume 0.35 placed at burn_start + 0.1s.
avoid_for: Short-form fast cuts — 0.6s is heavy for cuts/min 5+
hyperframes_alternative: GSAP: layer a div with bg radial-gradient orange/amber on top of clipA, tween opacity 0→1 over 0.6s with blend-mode:screen. Reveal clipB underneath.
canonical_observations: Not observed in 8 canonical refs. F1 canonical set has no cinema-setting refs (mina, carretera, acuario, cockpit, fundición, metro, tren, eléctrica). Cinema sub-genre transition kept for sub-genre-specific use (cinema-abandonado project) only. Do NOT use as default in horror-choice reels. Recipe remains valid for cinema-aesthetic projects pending F2 cinema-genre referent set.
validated_notes: 0/8 F1 canonical observations. Sub-genre-specific (cinema). Keep available but require explicit SPEC justification ('setting = cinema/drive-in/projector room' OR 'memory-into-vintage-footage device').
